name.en: People's Republic of China passport / travel-document photo
name.zh: 中华人民共和国护照 / 旅行证照片

issuer: National Immigration Administration / Chinese diplomatic missions

notes.en: Chinese consular page (same wording on multiple MFA missions): colour print taken within 6 months; white background; 33 mm wide × 48 mm high; head width 15–22 mm; head height (chin to crown) 28–33 mm (about 0.583–0.688 of 48 mm); 3–5 mm from crown to the top edge; at least 7 mm from chin to the bottom edge. Full face visible; glasses allowed if untinted and without glare. Pixel size, file limits, and DPI are not stated. Domestic applications follow the NIA “出入境证件相片照相指引” archive and may be captured in office; this entry records the published millimetre rules used by missions.
notes.zh: 中国驻外使领馆页（多馆表述一致）：6 个月内彩色纸质近照；白底；宽 33 mm、高 48 mm；头部宽 15–22 mm；头部高（下巴到头顶）28–33 mm（约占 48 mm 的 0.583–0.688）；头顶到上边 3–5 mm；下巴到下边不少于 7 mm。须含整个面部；可戴无色、无反光眼镜。未写像素、文件限制与 DPI。境内申请另循国家移民管理局《出入境证件相片照相指引》，可能现场采集；本条记录馆方公布的毫米规则。
